highlights.title: Egyptian TV presenter Sarah Khalifa sentenced to death in drug case
highlights.summary: Sarah Khalifa, a well-known Egyptian TV presenter, has been sentenced to death for her involvement in a drug ring, state media reported over the weekend. Eleven others were also convicted in the case and handed a death sentence. Khalifa is best known for her program “Mission Impossible”.

highlights.title: AI: The future of smart households?
highlights.summary: Could artificial intelligence soon be running our households? Beyond our smartphones, AI is now powering everything from fridges to lawnmowers. The International Household Appliances Fair in Berlin gives us a glimpse into what's next.

highlights.title: Ataques israelenses matam quatro no sul do Líbano; presidente pede ajuda dos EUA para conter escalada
highlights.summary:
Ataques israelenses mataram quatro pessoas, incluindo duas mulheres, no sul do Líbano neste domingo (6), informou o Ministério da Saúde libanês. Tel Aviv afirmou que os bombardeios eram uma retaliação a uma ofensiva de drones do Hezbollah contra áreas ocupadas por suas tropas.
